label: Field between parallel plates
subgoals: Divide the voltage by the plate spacing
Express the field in megavolts per metre
Multiply by epsilon to get the surface charge density

label: Parallel-plate capacitance
subgoals: Multiply eps0 by epsilon r and the plate area
Express the result in femtofarads with eps0 in fF per um

label: Layered dielectrics
subgoals: Divide each layer thickness by its relative permittivity
Add the ratios as series contributions
Divide eps0 times area by the sum
